yourNature_desc: You are what the sword is like when it is drawn and never hung back on the wall. You hold more Metal than any day spends, and the surplus turns into an urge to speak the truth. Because it never rests, you would rather say the hard thing today than keep the peace. You earn deep trust that way, and over time you pay for it in easy closeness.

self_card.face: A blade that never leaves the hand
self_card.presence: You run full, carrying more truth than any one moment asks for. You spend your strength holding it back or paying for letting it out.
